definition: the quality of being cool or cold.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಗಾಳಿಯ ತಣ್ಣಿತು ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಹಿತವೆನಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The coolness of the breeze on the hill felt pleasant to the mind.

definition: to put forward a trough (having water or food) for animals.
example_en: The farmer put forward a trough for the cattle.

definition: to get excited from excess joy of success, achievement, etc.
example_en: The players got wildly excited with joy at winning the match.

definition: to become more in number, increase.
example_en: In the rainy season, the river's water increased.

definition: a low, woody plant with several permanent stems instead of a single trunk; a bush; a shrub.
example_en: A thick bush had grown at the edge of the forest.

definition: (myth.) name of a hell.
example_en: Sinners fall into the hell called Suvaktra and suffer there.

definition: any form of wealth employed or capable of being employed in the production of more wealth; capital.
example_en: Capital is needed to open a shop.

definition: the pavilion in front of a temple.
example_en: The devotees sat and waited in the pavilion in front of the temple.

definition: a thin liquid.
example_en: That medicine's thin liquid was bitter.

definition: a course of austere penance.
example_en: That sage was performing an austere penance in the forest.

definition: any of various classes (esp. Bryopsida) of very small, green bryophytes having stems with leaflike structures and growing in velvety clusters on rocks; moss.
example_en: The moss had grown green on the rock.

definition: the line drawn around a playground, as cricket field, indicating the boundary.
example_en: The players noticed the ball that crossed the boundary line.

definition: the natural habitationof animals.
example_en: That forest was the natural habitation of birds.

definition: the hair growing on the head.
example_en: Her hair on the head has grown thick.

definition: a daughter of one's son or daughter; a grand-daughter.
example_en: The granddaughter was listening to stories from her grandfather.

definition: that which is decided; determination; decision.
example_en: The meeting's decision was agreeable to everyone.

definition: to pour or cause to flow down continuously.
example_en: The rainwater is pouring down continuously from the roof.

definition: the ability to use one's knowledge effectively and readily in execution or performance.
example_en: His skillfulness finished the work quickly.

definition: the act or an instance of cheating.
example_en: Everyone came to know about his cheating in gambling.

definition: the quality of being rough.
example: ಈ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯ ಉರುಟು ಕೈಗೆ ಚುಚ್ಚುವಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The roughness of this stone's surface felt prickly to the hand.

definition: a regulated outlet for water; a sluice.
example_en: They opened the sluice to let water flow into the field.

definition: a method, manner or way.
example: ಇದನ್ನು ಮಾಡುವ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಮಾಳ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದೆಂದು ಕಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They taught the correct method of doing this.

definition: a man taking ideas, passages, entire work, etc. from another and pass them off as one's own; plagiarism.
example: ಆ ಕಬ್ಬಿಗಗಳ್ಳ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬರ ಕವನವನ್ನು ತನ್ನದೆಂದು ಹೇಳಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: That plagiarist claimed someone else's poem as his own.

definition: the quality of being firmly resolved, determined; firmness of the mind; resoluteness.
example: ಅವನು ಹಟ ಬಿಡದೆ ತನ್ನ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಸಾಧಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He achieved his goal without giving up his resolve.

definition: the driver of a chariot; a charioteer.
example_en: The charioteer drove the chariot slowly.

definition: to turn (to one side); to incline toward.
example_en: He sat turning his face to one side.

definition: an object which the mind cannot comprehend; an incomprehensible thing.
example_en: His question is incomprehensible to me.

definition: the feats or gymnastics of an acrobat; acrobatics.
example_en: The acrobatics attracted people at the fair.

definition: quenching; extinguishing; putting out.
example: ಆ ಔಷಧ ನೋವನ್ನು ಶಾಮಕವಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That medicine works as a quenching agent for pain.

definition: a man who transgresses the social, moral or religious customs; a man guilty of apostasy; a renegade; an apostate.
example_en: The villagers excommunicated the apostate.

definition: a self-conceited, arrogant man.
example_en: The arrogant man kept talking only about himself.

definition: a decorated frame work on a slightly raised platform for putting idols or for the bride and bridegroom to sit in.
example_en: The bride and bridegroom were seated on the decorated platform.

definition: to be lessened in quantity, size, intensity, degree, etc.
example_en: As the rainy season comes, the water level decreases.

definition: collectively, one's relations.
example_en: On the festival day all the relatives gathered together.

definition: the quality of being honest.
example_en: His honesty earned everyone's admiration.

definition: to take off; to remove (as dress, outer covering etc.).
example_en: Take off the boots after the game.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example_en: That crystal glistened in the sunlight.

definition: the dust sitting on the foot or feet.
example_en: Walking the whole way, dust filled his feet.

definition: to make a straight furrow using a plough.
example_en: He made a straight furrow in the field with the plough.

definition: without doing or saying anything; idly.
example_en: He sat idly and did nothing.

definition: shelter or protection from danger, difficulty, etc.; refuge.
example_en: He found refuge to escape from the storm.

definition: to mince into small pieces.
example_en: The cook minced the meat into small pieces.

definition: an indiclinable used to drive out or forward cattle, dogs, etc.
example: ರೈತ ಹಚ ಎಂದು ಕೂಗಿ ಎತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಓಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer shouted 'hacha' and drove the oxen forward.

definition: a headgear made of a long lose cloth hemmed decoratively with gold and silver threads.
example_en: At the wedding, she wore a headgear made of a long cloth hemmed with gold.

definition: gone out; moved outward; departed.
example_en: He departed from home and went to the city.

definition: a dark color that is a blend of red and blue; purple.
example_en: The color of her sari was purple.

definition: a woman belonging to and residing in the nation of her birth; a native.
example: ಆ ನಾಡಿಗಿತ್ತಿ ತನ್ನ ಹುಟ್ಟೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗೌರವದಿಂದ ಬದುಕುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಳೆ.
example_en: That native woman lives with respect in her birthplace.

definition: a Muslim priest.
example_en: The Muslim priest gave a sermon in the mosque.

definition: that is subject to invasion; invaded; taken into possession; seized.
example_en: The enemy army occupied that region.

definition: sweetly; deliciously.
example_en: That fruit melted sweetly and deliciously in the mouth.

definition: the sky.
example_en: Birds were flying about in the sky.

definition: a huge army.
example_en: The king's huge army advanced toward the border.

definition: a man who competes in a contest; a contestant.
example_en: The contestants competed with each other for the prize.

definition: not sanitary; harmful to health; unhealthy; likely to cause disease; unsanitary.
example_en: That slum area is unsanitary and unhealthy.

definition: an aggrieved or distressed woman.
example: ಗಂಡನ ನಷ್ಟದಿಂದ ದುಃಖಾರ್ತೆಯಾದ ಅವಳು ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಇದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The woman, distressed by her husband's loss, stayed at home.

definition: the official language of Sri Lanka; the Singhalese language.
example: ಶ್ರೀಲಂಕಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಜನರು ಸಿಂಹಳಿ ಭಾಷೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Most people in Sri Lanka speak the Sinhalese language.

definition: name of a region in the Western India, that runs from the present Thane in north to Goa in south, and between Sahyādri mountains and Arabian sea.
example: ಕೊಂಗಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶ ಸಹ್ಯಾದ್ರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅರಬ್ಬಿ ಸಮುದ್ರದ ನಡುವೆ ಹರಡಿದೆ.
example_en: The Konkan region stretches between the Sahyadri mountains and the Arabian sea.

definition: to press (the lips) together and part them suddenly so as to make a smack; to smack.
example_en: The old woman ate the sweet fruit and smacked her lips.

definition: of or having the same relationship toward, each other or one another; mutual.
example_en: The two of them helped each other mutually.

definition: causing enzyme.
example_en: This chemical has an enzyme-causing property.

definition: a brilliant, hexagonally crystalline mineral, silicon dioxide, SiO2, occurring in abundance, most often in a colourless, transparent form, but also sometimes in coloured varieties used as semiprecious stones; quartz.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಳಿಯ ಕಂಕರಕಲ್ಲು ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: White quartz is found in abundance on that hill.

definition: (a cattle) to eat fodder.
example_en: The cows ate fodder in the field.

definition: a man who does not take part in either side of a dispute or quarrel.
example_en: That person remained neutral in the quarrel.

definition: to be attentive; to be careful or watchful.
example_en: The children were attentive to the teacher's words.

definition: the characteristic stimulation of any specific substance upon the olfactory nerves; odour; scent; smell.
example: ಈ ಹೂವಿನ ಗಂದ ತುಂಬಾ ಸುವಾಸನೆಯಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿದೆ.
example_en: The scent of this flower is full of fragrance.

definition: the act of applying light touches or strokes to (a person or part of a person's body) so as to excite the nerves and usu. produce laughter and spasmodic movement; tickle; a tickling.
example_en: The elder sister tickled her younger brother and played with him.

definition: an improper time.
example_en: It is not good to travel at an improper time.

definition: to decorate, embellish oneself.
example_en: Before the wedding she decorated herself beautifully.

definition: an abraded area of the skin.
example: ಕಾಲಿಗೆ ಆದ ಗಾಯದ ಕಿಣ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The abraded mark from the wound on the leg was still there.

definition: the small, lithe, soft-furred animal, Felis cattus of Felidae family, domesticated since ancient times and often kept as a pet or for killing mice; a cat.
example_en: The house cat chased the mouse.

definition: (wood, furniture, etc.) to be eaten by termites.
example_en: The old wooden cupboard has been eaten by termites.

definition: suddenly; all of a sudden.
example_en: The bird flew away suddenly.

definition: a variety in ginger (family: Zingiberaceae) known for its aromatic rhizome.
example_en: They use aromatic ginger for medicine.

definition: the form of potassium nitrate, KNO3, that occurs naturally, used in the manufacture of fireworks, fluxes, gunpowder, etc.; niter; saltpeter.
example_en: Saltpeter is used to manufacture fireworks.

definition: to move forward by or as by crawling.
example_en: The snake moved forward crawling through the grass.

definition: a single or the same level.
example_en: All the students were brought to a single level.

definition: excessive grief.
example_en: On hearing that news she felt excessive grief.

definition: (a group) to disperse; to scatter.
example_en: As soon as the police arrived, the group scattered.

definition: the yam plant Dioscorea sativa (var. pulchella); cumin yam plant.
example_en: The farmer grew the cumin yam plant in his field.

definition: an artificial water, esp. for irrigation; a canal.
example_en: They dug a canal to bring water to the field.

definition: an inauspicious moment.
example: ಪುರೋಹಿತರು ಅಪಲಗ್ನ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಬೇಡ ಎಂದರು.
example_en: The priest said not to travel during an inauspicious moment.

definition: absence of orderliness; disorder; chaos.
example_en: The arrangement of the meeting appeared chaotic.

definition: to work (dough, clay, etc. with the hands) into a uniform and homogeneous mixture by pressing, folding, and stretching and make it a pliable mass.
example_en: The cook kneaded the dough well.

definition: the three-pointed antlers of a sambar.
example_en: The hunter recognised the sambar with three-pointed antlers.

definition: without working; being inactive; idly.
example: ಅವಳು ಉಂತೆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ಸಮಯ ವ್ಯರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She sat inactive at home and wasted time.

definition: a water lily plant, Nelumbo nucifera.
example_en: The water lily flowers were floating on the pond.

definition: the state of being diminished, depressed, dwarfish or miserable.
example_en: Due to poverty his life fell into misery and diminishment.

definition: happening without reason or cause; accidental; fortuitous.
example_en: That accident happened without any reason.

definition: an abrasive paper coated with pulverised glass and used like sandpaper; a glass-paper.
example_en: The carpenter rubbed the wooden plank with glass-paper.

definition: a strong piece of bone.
example_en: The chicken's strong bone did not break easily.

definition: the area, place or space below.
example_en: I have kept the books in the space below the cupboard.

definition: any work done in a forest.
example_en: He spent the whole day doing work in the forest.

definition: the deliberate breaking of faith; betrayal of trust; treachery; perfidy.
example: ಅವನ ಹುಳುಕು ಬುದ್ಧಿಯಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬ ನಾಶವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: His treachery destroyed the whole family.

definition: the quality of being boastful.
example_en: Everyone knew about his boastfulness.

definition: a foolish, stupid woman.
example_en: That foolish woman stood there understanding nothing.

definition: one who sacrificed his life for a noble cause; a martyr.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕ ದೇಶಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಆಹುತಾತ್ಮನಾದನು.
example_en: That soldier became a martyr who gave his life for the nation.

definition: a powder used like toothpaste; tooth-powder.
example_en: Grandmother applied the tooth-powder to her finger and brushed her teeth.

definition: a wooden hammer.
example_en: The carpenter struck the nail with a wooden hammer.

definition: a room designed to store grain; a barn.
example_en: Rats had eaten the grain inside the barn.

definition: a fence of persons (surrounding an object and standing close to each other) as to guard or restrict movement, etc.
example_en: There was a fence of soldiers standing guard around the king.

definition: an expert in performing magic; a magician.
example: ಆ ಮಾಯಕಾಱ ಕಣ್ಣುಮುಚ್ಚಿ ತೆರೆಯುವಷ್ಟರಲ್ಲಿ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಮಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದ.
example_en: That expert magician made the object vanish in the blink of an eye.

definition: to fear; to be afraid or scared of.
example_en: The child got scared at the sound of thunder.

definition: a small, passerine bird of Motacillidae family, with long wing feathers and a very long tail that wags up and down; a wag tail.
example_en: The wagtail was searching for insects in the green grass.

definition: a man-like, masculine woman.
example: ಆ ಗಂಡಿಗಿತಿ ಯಾವ ಪುರುಷನಿಗೂ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That masculine woman is inferior to no man.

definition: the portion around the anus of a horse.
example_en: The veterinarian examined the area around the horse's anus.

definition: rhythmic movement of the body and feet ordinarily to music; an instance of dance performance; dance.
example: ಆ ಕಲಾವಿದೆಯ ನಟನ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಮೋಡಿ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That artist's dance enchanted everyone.

definition: to become soft, tender.
example_en: The skin became soft in the hot water.

definition: consumed by a big, destructive fire.
example_en: Not a single tree remained in the forest consumed by the great fire.

definition: the cardinal number sixty; 60.
example_en: In numerology, ṣaṣṭi means sixty.

definition: to twist with the fingers the ends of two threads to join them.
example: ಅವಳು ಎರಡು ದಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಕೆಚ್ಚು ಮಾಡಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She twisted and joined the two threads together.

definition: the plant Alpinia galangas of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: They use the roots of the Alpinia galanga plant for medicine.

definition: one who manages a business, institution, etc.; a manager.
example: ನಮ್ಮ ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜರು ಇಂದು ಸಭೆ ಕರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: Our company's manager has called a meeting today.

definition: self-praising.
example: ಅವನ ವಿಕತ್ಥನ ಮಾತುಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಬೇಸರ ತಂದವು.
example_en: His self-praising words annoyed everyone.

definition: a kind of wild bee.
example: ದಾಲ ಎಂಬ ಕಾಡು ಜೇನುನೊಣ ಹೂವಿನ ಸುತ್ತ ಹಾರುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The wild bee called dala was flying around the flower.

definition: an outlet in a tank for water in excess of certain level or capacity to flow out.
example_en: During the rainy season, water flows out through the tank's outlet.

definition: a sharp, penetrating look.
example_en: He stared at the enemy with his sharp, penetrating look.

definition: a lord; a master.
example_en: Our master did not come to the office today.

definition: a small pouch or bag tied to the waist.
example_en: She tied a silver coin in the pouch at her waist.

definition: a running with long strides.
example_en: He ran with long strides to catch the bus.

definition: one's own father.
example_en: He never went against his own father's words.

definition: a kind of deasease affecting the flesh in the body.
example_en: The doctors treated his flesh disease.

definition: a physically powerful, strong man.
example: ಆ ಶಕ್ತ ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ಬಂಡೆಯನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ಹಾಕಿದ.
example_en: That strong man lifted the boulder all alone.

definition: a small enclosure for calves.
example_en: The calves had been tied up in the small enclosure.

definition: the third day of the week; Tuesday.
example_en: On Tuesday, there is a lot of crowd in the market.

definition: indistinct or wrong pronunciation.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಉಚ್ಚಾರಣೆಗಿಂತ ವಿಕ್ಲಿಷ್ಟವೇ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In his speech there was more indistinct pronunciation than clear pronunciation.

definition: a kind of plant.
example: ಕಣಿವೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಬೇಳು ಗಿಡ ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The bēḷu plant grows abundantly near the valley.

definition: (pl.) two streams.
example: ಆ ಇದ್ದೊಱೆ ಒಂದೇ ಬೆಟ್ಟದಿಂದ ಹುಟ್ಟಿ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: Those two streams rise from the same hill and join below.

definition: to have the difference; to be differentiated.
example_en: It became clear that the two opinions were differentiated.

definition: a cloth in gen.
example_en: Various kinds of cloth were for sale in the shop.

definition: half-baked food.
example_en: The half-baked food cooked in a hurry could not be eaten.

definition: to become seen; to appear; to physically manifest (oneself).
example_en: The sun appeared from behind the clouds.

definition: the depression in the center of the surface of the abdomen indicating the point of attachment of the umbilical cord to the embryo; the navel.
example_en: The infant's navel has not yet fully dried.

definition: a kind of grass.
example_en: Only a kind of grass grew on the barren land.

definition: the sexual relation (between a man and a woman).
example: ಮದುವೆಯ ನಂತರ ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ದೇಹಸಂಬಂಧ ಏರ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: After marriage, a sexual relationship was formed between the two of them.

definition: the period of one's life that is past one's youth.
example_en: In the period past her youth, she developed an interest in meditation.

definition: the thick, stringy mucus secreted by the mucous glands of the respiratory tract and discharged from the throat, as during a cold; phlegm.
example_en: Phlegm had filled up in the throat due to the cold.

definition: performance of a religious sacrifice.
example: ಪುರೋಹಿತನಿಗೆ ಯಾಜನದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The priest had deep knowledge about the performance of sacrifice.

definition: a thrusting blow with the fist; a punch.
example_en: He struck a punch on the opponent's face.

definition: to restrict; to retrain - a) to hold back from action; check; suppress; curb; b) to keep under control.
example_en: He restrained his anger.

definition: a controlling or keeping under check.
example_en: One should meditate to achieve control over the mind.

definition: a tradesman; a merchant; a trader.
example_en: That merchant traded in cloth.

definition: the vine Cucumis melo ( = C. aromaticus, = C. utilissimus) of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The farmer grew the melon vine in the field.

definition: the act or art of carving wood, chiselling stone, casting or welding metal, moulding clay or wax, etc. into three-dimensional representations, as statues, figures, forms, etc. sculpture.
example_en: The sculpture on the temple wall is exquisite.

definition: a medicine, food or habit, that enhances one's longevity.
example_en: The doctor recommended a longevity-enhancing medicine.

definition: an alloy of tin and lead.
example_en: That vessel was made from an alloy of tin and lead.

definition: a variable, multiple star, the brightest one in the constellation Leo, with a magnitude of 1.3; Regulus.
example_en: Regulus shone brightly in the night sky.

definition: a wreath or woven chain of flowers; a garland.
example_en: They tied a garland of flowers on the temple door.

definition: to enter the battle field.
example_en: The brave soldier bravely entered the battle field.

definition: a person who eats meat.
example_en: The meat-eater included fish in his meal.

definition: a putting forth a subject for discussing or deliberating over.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನು ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸ್ತಾಪ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He put forth this subject for discussion in the meeting.

definition: a kind of field rat.
example_en: The field rat had dug a burrow in the field.

definition: an abscess that is black (?).
example_en: A black abscess formed on his leg and caused pain.

definition: a tormenting, troubling repeatedly; harassment; annoyance.
example_en: He was annoyed by the neighbour's constant harassment.

definition: any material used for enhancing the beauty, as dress ornament, etc.
example_en: She wore various ornaments for the wedding.

definition: short, loose trousers reaching to the knee; shorts.
example_en: There were knee-length shorts in the school uniform.

definition: a physical exercise in which a person standing with legs placed closer, folds his knee and sits without his bottom touching the ground and stands up, and repeats the same.
example: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನೂರು ಊಟಬೈಸು ಮಾಡುವುದು ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು.
example_en: Doing a hundred squats every day is good for health.

definition: a sensible, rational man.
example_en: That rational man thinks about everything logically.

definition: the quality of being appropriate; aptness; propriety; suitability; fitness.
example: ಈ ಎರಡು ಬಣ್ಣಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾದ ಸಾಮಂಜಸ್ಯ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a fine harmony between these two colors.

definition: a man who plunders; a plunderer.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈಸೂಱೆಗಾಱ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನೆಯನ್ನೂ ಲೂಟಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: In that village, the plunderer looted every single house.

definition: the tree Olea europaea of Oleaceae family; oleaster tree; European olive.
example_en: Oil is prepared from the olive tree.

definition: the plant Curcuma xanthorrhiza of Zingiberaceae family.
example_en: The roots of the Curcuma xanthorrhiza plant are used in medicine.

definition: a groove, furrow or track, esp. one made in the ground by the passage of wheeled vehicles.
example: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಆಳವಾದ ಜೇಡು ಮೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A deep track had formed on the road during the monsoon.

definition: to talk quietly or furtively, as in gossiping; to whisper.
example_en: She whispered softly into his ear.

definition: in total; as a whole; altogether.
example_en: This work is finished altogether.

definition: a group of people assisting a chief officer in a government office, company or any other organisation; staff.
example_en: The office staff were engaged in work.

definition: to engage in agriculture, as cultivating of land, raising of crops, etc.
example_en: The farmers engaged in agriculture in the field.

definition: the act of making a continuous jarring sound.
example_en: Because of the continuous jarring sound of the wind, the baby did not sleep.

definition: a putting (of others money, resources, etc.) to a wrong use; misappropriation.
example_en: The officer misappropriated government funds.

definition: a compound of antimony, a poisonous substance.
example_en: The one who consumed the antimony compound suffered poisoning.

definition: a male ruler of a nation or state usu. called a kingdom; a king; a ruler; a monarch.
example: ಆ ಧೊರೆ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That king used to rule his subjects with love.

definition: a track of land having lumpy surface with gravel.
example: ಆ ಹಱಿಮಣ್ ಜಮೀನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟ.
example_en: It is difficult to grow crops on that gravelly, lumpy land.

definition: the act of one who seizes or an instance of this; seizure; holding.
example_en: He gained a great profit from the seizure of the property.

definition: a damaged, mutilated leg.
example_en: Due to the accident, his leg became a mutilated leg.

definition: without covering or clothing; naked; nude; bare.
example: ಬಡ ಮಗು ಬಱಿ ಕಾಲಿನಿಂದ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The poor child used to go to school with bare feet.

definition: a globe on which the stars, constellations, etc. are depicted in their proper relative positions in the sky; the celestial globe.
example_en: The science teacher showed the students the celestial globe.

definition: to cause to see.
example_en: He showed me the new house.

definition: the plant Physalis flexusa.
example_en: People use the Physalis flexusa plant for medicine.

definition: a face that expressing wrath, displeasure, etc.
example: ಆ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಅವಳ ಪೊಗೆಮೊಗ ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೆದರಿದರು.
example_en: Seeing her angry face after hearing those words, everyone was frightened.

definition: either of the two forelimbs of most birds and of bats that are specialised for flight; the wing.
example_en: The bat's wing was clearly visible in the dark.

definition: something whispered (as a secret); that which is uttered furtively; whispering.
example_en: No one heard the whispering between the two friends.

definition: a long, narrow piece of cloth with which a head-gear is made.
example_en: The king had his turban tied with the long cloth strip.

definition: to cause to wear (an ornament, dress, shackles, etc.) 2.to place in a sitting or convenient position; to set.
example_en: The mother made her daughter wear a gold chain.

definition: any of a subfamily (Crocodylinae) of large, flesh-eating, lizard-like crocodilian reptiles living in or around tropical streams and having thick, horny skin composed of scales and plates, a long tail, and a long, narrow, triangular head with massive jaws; a crocodile.
example_en: A crocodile was basking in the sun on the riverbank.

definition: that is acting, functioning, working, moving, etc.; active.
example: ಆ ಯುವಕನು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಕ್ರಿಯನಾಗಿ ಪಾಲ್ಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That young man participates actively in all activities.

definition: a washing or dipping of a thing, esp. the body, in water or other liquid, steam, etc.; a bath.
example: ದಿನದ ಕೆಲಸದ ನಂತರ ಅವನು ನದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಜ್ಜಣ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: After the day's work he had a bath in the river.

definition: to begin to be day; to dawn.
example_en: As the day began to dawn, the birds chirped.

definition: unrefined, coarse or vulgar speech.
example: ಆ ಮನುಷ್ಯ ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾನುಡಿಯಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೇಸರಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That man used coarse, vulgar speech in the assembly and annoyed everyone.

definition: a kind of animal.
example_en: An animal called beṭṭagedallu was seen in the forest.

definition: to grasp mentally; take note (of); observe; to know; to perceive.
example_en: The disciple grasped the teacher's instruction.

definition: a flow or the force of flow of water, esp. in spate.
example_en: After the rain, the force of the river's flow was strong.

definition: joy; delight; pleasantness of the mood.
example_en: The house was full of joy on the child's birthday.

definition: wild or violent mental disorder, as the manic phase of manic-depressive psychosis, characterised gen. by abnormal excitability, exaggerated feelings of well-being, flight of ideas, excessive activity, etc.; mania.
example_en: He had a fit of mania and behaved strangely.

definition: for that reason; therefore; consequent to.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂತು, ಅತ ಏವ ನಾವು ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲೇ ಉಳಿದೆವು.
example_en: It rained, therefore we stayed at home.

definition: to cause to catch fire.
example_en: They set fire to the dry grass.

definition: a labour extracted by force without compensation.
example_en: The villagers had to do forced, unpaid labour for the landlord.

definition: to strike against.
example_en: The ball struck against the window.

definition: (in pl.) six faces.
example: ಆ ದೇವತೆಗೆ ಆಱುದಲೆಗಳಿವೆ ಎಂದು ಪುರಾಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The legend says that deity has six faces.

definition: a workman who builds and repairs wooden things, esp. the wooden parts of buildings, ships, etc.; a carpenter.
example_en: The carpenter carved the house door beautifully.

definition: a disputing; an argument; a debate; a dispute.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಜಮೀನಿನ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವಾದ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A dispute arose between the two over the matter of land.

definition: an uncultured, uncivilised, barbarous man.
example: ಆ ಸಂಸ್ಕಾರಹೀನ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮುಂದೆ ಅಸಭ್ಯವಾಗಿ ವರ್ತಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That uncultured man behaved rudely in front of everyone.

definition: a very common name for villages or towns in Karnāṭaka.
example_en: There is a village called Madduru near our town.

definition: to throw or pitch about; to toss.
example_en: The boys tossed the ball up into the sky.

definition: a man who gathers things that have been discarded by others; a scavenger.
example_en: The scavenger picks up the things thrown away on the street.

definition: a knob - a) a rounded lump or protuberance; b) a ball-like handle of a door, drawer, etc.; c) a similar device used in controlling the operation of equipments as a radio, TV receiver, etc.
example: ಬಾಗಿಲಿನ ಗುಪಟೆ ಹಿಡಿದು ಅವನು ಒಳಕ್ಕೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He came inside holding the doorknob.

definition: the quality or fact of being slang.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನ ಅಶಿಷ್ಟತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇರಿಸುಮುರಿಸು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The slangy vulgarity of his speech embarrassed everyone.

definition: the profession of a guard.
example_en: He has been working as a guard since a young age.

definition: the wife of a barber.
example_en: The barber's wife served food to her husband.

definition: to grow plants, crops,etc.
example_en: The farmer grows paddy in the field.

definition: the grass Sorghum halpense ( = Andropogonhalpensis) of Poaceae family.
example_en: The wild sorghum grass had grown on the field's edge.

definition: name of a petty goddess.
example_en: The girls broke coconuts for the goddess Baduve.

definition: of white colour.
example_en: She came wearing a white-coloured garment.

definition: (rhet.) a statement that seems contradictory, unbelievable or absurd but that may be true in fact; a paradox.
example_en: A beautiful paradox is hidden in that poem.

definition: to achieve one's aim; to accomplish one's purpose.
example_en: Through hard effort he achieved his aim.

definition: one night.
example_en: They stayed in that town for one night.

definition: an obstruction; a hindrance.
example: ಆ ಮನಾಯಿಯ ಕಾರಣ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The work could not proceed because of that obstruction.

definition: an assemblage of women.
example_en: An assemblage of women had gathered at the meeting.

definition: not mutually related; lacking mutual connection; uncorrelated.
example_en: These two events appear to be uncorrelated.

definition: to turn one's face aside, from disapproval, repugnance.
example_en: He turned his face aside in disgust.

definition: the general life span of people in a country.
example_en: The life expectancy of that country has recently increased.

definition: the main or essential part of a matter; gist.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನ ಹುದು ಏನೆಂದು ನನಗೆ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: I did not understand the gist of what he was saying.

definition: an impediment; an obstruction.
example_en: An obstruction arose in the middle of the ceremony.

definition: to take out the juice (from a fruit) by squeezing.
example_en: She squeezed the lemon to take out its juice.

definition: a beast of prey.
example_en: In the forest the beast of prey called shibi hunted.

definition: not to be wearied out; unremitting in effort; indefatigable.
example_en: The indefatigable worker laboured all night.

definition: the army of one's enemy.
example_en: The general observed the movements of the enemy army.

definition: the cardinal number thirty; 30.
example_en: She is now thirty years old.

definition: degree of darkness of a colour; a shade.
example_en: The shade of that cloth was very elegant.

definition: a lake, pond, having red lotus plants.
example_en: Red lotuses had blossomed in the lake outside the village.

definition: the tree Hardwickia binata (= H. pinnata) of Caesalpiniaceae family; Malabar Mahagany.
example_en: Kammara trees grow in that forest.

definition: any of various diseases caused by malfunction of the intestinal juice or juices.
example_en: He got a stomach ache due to a disease caused by malfunction of the intestinal juices.

definition: to be scorched or charred from excess heat.
example_en: The bread kept on the pan got scorched.

definition: a metal (esp. of gold or silver) band.
example_en: There was a gold band on her hand.

definition: the plant Cocculus hirsutus ( = C. villosus) of Menispermaceae family.
example_en: Yadaniballi grows on the fence.

definition: sexual intercourse; coition.
example: ಆ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಸಿಲಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರವಾಗಿ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: That book describes sexual intercourse in detail.

definition: not won; not overpowered.
example_en: He lost in that unwon competition.

definition: friendly relation; friendship.
example: ಅವರಿಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವಿನ ಸುಹೃತ್ವ ಬಹಳ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The friendship between the two of them had existed for many years.

definition: wide knowledge; scholarship.
example: ಆ ಗುರುಗಳ ಬಿನ್ನಾಯ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That teacher's scholarship was famous throughout the town.

definition: interwoven; intertwined.
example_en: The threads of that cloth were intertwined with one another.

definition: a hunting of wild animals for sport.
example_en: The kings used to go hunting in the forest.

definition: a man who decorates; a decorator.
example_en: The decorator decorated the wedding pavilion beautifully.

definition: a letter sent or to be sent, through a messenger.
example: ಆ ಅಟ್ಟೋಲೆ ದೂತನ ಮೂಲಕ ಅರಮನೆಗೆ ತಲುಪಿತು.
example_en: That letter reached the palace through a messenger.

definition: to be afraid of; to fear; to be distressed by the emotion of fear.
example_en: The travellers who lost their way in the dark became afraid.

definition: a variety of paddy.
example: ಡುಣ್ಣ ಎಂಬ ಬತ್ತದ ತಳಿ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
example_en: The paddy variety called dunna is famous here.

definition: a man working in metal.
example_en: The metalworker struck the hot iron with a hammer.

definition: the plant Daucus carota of Apiaceae family with fernlike leaves, compound umbels of white flowers.
example_en: She put pieces of carrot into the soup.

definition: the sense of fear.
example_en: The child felt fear in the darkness.

definition: the quality of being lusterous; lustre; brilliance.
example_en: The lustre of that diamond was dazzling.

definition: a honourable prefix to men's names.
example: ಜನರು ಆತನನ್ನು ಗೌರವದಿಂದ ಅಪ್ಪಡಿ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: People used to address him respectfully with the prefix appadi.

definition: a judicial body, whether civil, ecclesiastical or military which is authorised by the natioṇs law to try law cases, make investigations, and to dispense justice; a court of law.
example_en: The hearing of that case took place in the court of law.

definition: to excite the surface nerves of, as by touching or stroking lightly with the finger, a feather, etc., so as to cause involuntary twitching, a pleasant tingling, laughter, etc.; to tickle.
example_en: The child tickled its mother's hand with a feather.

definition: a track or way worn by footsteps in a forest.
example_en: The villagers used to go to the forest through the footpath.

definition: the husband of one's sister; a brother-in-law.
example_en: My sister's husband does business in the town.

definition: a person who is disloyal to or who acts against the interest of, the country he or she is living in.
example_en: The soldiers arrested the traitor.

definition: (masc.) an expert in any of the fine arts.
example: ಆ ಕಲಾಕಲಿತ ಸಂಗೀತ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿತ್ರಕಲೆ ಎರಡರಲ್ಲೂ ನಿಪುಣ.
example_en: That expert is skilled in both music and painting.

definition: a passage for water.
example: ಈ ಪಾಣಿಯಬಾರ ಮೂಲಕ ಕೆರೆಯ ನೀರು ಗದ್ದೆಗೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Through this passage for water, the lake's water flows to the paddy field.

definition: a thick thorn.
example_en: A thick thorn pricked on the path and the leg hurt.

definition: a patch or blemish discolouring the skin very much; plentifulness of such blotches on the body.
example_en: Dark blotches were visible all over his face.

definition: to show, exhibit a symbol.
example_en: He exhibited a symbol of his wealth.

definition: to undertake a vow.
example_en: The devotee undertook a vow of fasting to the god.

definition: a container made of dried gourd of certain trees.
example_en: He filled water into the gourd container.

definition: a thick, twisted rope (used to tie elephants).
example_en: The mahout tied up the elephant with the thick twisted rope.

definition: the wife of a Muslim king.
example_en: The queen walked into the palace.

definition: the spiny shrub Berberis aristata of Berberidaceae family, with sour, red berries and yellow flowers, grown as hedge-plant.
example_en: They planted the spiny barberry shrub as a hedge.

definition: a stringed, musical instrument.
example_en: She played the stringed instrument melodiously.

definition: free, unoccupied time during which a person may indulge in rest, recreation, etc.
example: ರಜೆಯ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ಸಾವಕಾಶ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: He gets plenty of leisure time during the holidays.

definition: a play, gesture etc. to arouse sexual feelings or desire; mutual sexual stimulation preceding sexual intercourse.
example: ಅವಳ ಕೊಯ್ಲೆಯ ಗೆಸ್ಚರುಗಳು ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆದವು.
example_en: Her amorous gestures captivated his mind.

definition: to gather and pile up (at one place).
example_en: The worker gathered and piled up all the bricks in one place.

definition: the fact or act of dying; cessation of life; end of a living being; death.
example: ಅವನ ಮೃತ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಊರಿಗೆ ಊರೇ ದುಃಖಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news of his death, the whole village grieved.

definition: a (woman's) parent's house.
example_en: The daughter went to her parents' house and spoke with her mother.

definition: an imaginary circle around the earth into Eastern and Northern hemispheres.
example_en: The equatorial line divides the earth into two parts.

definition: the chief administrative officer of a town.
example_en: The chief administrative officer of the town called a meeting.

definition: to set oneself against; to resist, argue against or be hostile to; to oppose.
example_en: He opposes everyone's words.

definition: a small, earthen plate.
example_en: Grandmother had kept pickle in a small earthen plate.

definition: any of the games of chance played for money or some other stakes; gambling.
example_en: Gambling was going on secretly in that house.

definition: to give the preparation made of betel leaves, lime and arecanut.
example_en: He ordered that the betel offering be given respectfully to the guests.

definition: Hebrew - a) the ancient Semitic language of the Israelites, in which most of the Old Testament was written; b) the modern form of this language, the official language of Israel.
example_en: The Old Testament is written in the Hebrew language.

definition: an enlargement of the thyroid gland, often visible as a swelling in the lower part of the front of the neck; goitre.
example_en: Goitre was seen in many people of the village.

definition: a glittering ornament.
example_en: A glittering ornament shone at the bride's neck.

definition: great splendour.
example_en: The great splendour of the festival spread through the whole town.

definition: the art or tactics of a procurer or procuress.
example: ಆ ಸ್ತ್ರೀ ಕುಂಟಣಿವಿದ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ ಜನರನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That woman used the tactics of a procuress to deceive people.

definition: a woman belonging to Musalman religion.
example_en: That Muslim woman was selling cloth in the market.

definition: to enter into; to come into.
example_en: The soldiers came into the fort.

definition: that which is exhibited (publicly).
example_en: People admired the exhibited items.

definition: the funeral rites; obsequies.
example_en: The family duly performed the funeral rites.

definition: a confused, jumbled condition, escaping from which is difficult.
example: ಈ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಯ ತೊಡಕು ಬಿಡಿಸಲು ಬಹಳ ಕಷ್ಟವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: It is very difficult to resolve the tangle of this problem.

definition: a room where normally meals are taken; a dining-room.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಉಂಬೊಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone ate together in the house's dining room.

definition: he who searches for.
example: ಆ ಅನ್ವೇಷಣಕಾರ ಹೊಸ ಔಷಧಿಗಾಗಿ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ನಡೆಸಿದ.
example_en: That researcher carried out a search for a new medicine.

definition: to get twisted, interwoven or intertwined with (another).
example_en: The two creepers got intertwined with each other.

definition: surrounding district; vicinity.
example_en: There are green gardens in the vicinity of his house.

definition: a war hero.
example_en: The war hero displayed valour on the battlefield.

definition: a witty statement or remark; a pun.
example_en: Everyone laughed hearing his witty remark.

definition: the act of correcting, rectifying.
example_en: The correcting of that article will finish tomorrow.

definition: a heavy staff; a club; a cudgel.
example_en: The watchman had a heavy club in his hand.

definition: a creeping plant or a low shrub.
example_en: A creeping plant had spread over the fence.

definition: any of usu. large gruiform wading birds of Gruidae family, with very long legs and neck, and a long, straight bill; a crane.
example_en: A crane was standing on the bank of the lake.

definition: to stretch one's body or a limb.
example_en: He got up in the morning and stretched his body.

definition: the condition of being perplexed; bewilderment; perplexity.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತುಗಳನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ನನಗೆ ಕುೞ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing his words, I was filled with bewilderment.

definition: a servant; an attendant.
example_en: That servant walked right behind his master.

definition: absence of wish or desire; disinclination.
example_en: He had a disinclination to go to work.

definition: favourable; auspicious; propitious.
example_en: This auspicious time is propitious.

definition: a place where four roads meet or where two roads intersect each other.
example_en: An accident happened near the crossroads.

definition: good or genuine intention.
example_en: Seeing his genuine intention, everyone trusted him.

definition: a beating of bush or bushes in an attempt to drive out animals as rabit, for hunting or catching.
example_en: The hunters beat the bushes to drive out the rabbit.

definition: a sweet, made of almond, and shaped like a small square or diamond.
example_en: Mother made almond halwa for the festival.

definition: a long thread, usu. coloured with turmeric powder, tied round the wrist of the right hand after worshipping a deity.
example: ಪೂಜೆಯ ನಂತರ ಅವಳು ಕೈಗೆ ಗಂಡ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: After the worship, she tied the turmeric thread on her wrist.

definition: a kind of comb used to pull out nits.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಈರಣಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಮಗುವಿನ ತಲೆಯಿಂದ ಹೇನುಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother removed the lice from the child's head with the nit comb.

definition: a building set apart or consecrated for Christian worship; a church.
example: ಆ ಇಗರ್ಚಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಭಾನುವಾರ ಪ್ರಾರ್ಥನೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Prayers are held every Sunday in that church.

definition: the hardy, annual composite plant, Lactuca sativa of Asteraceae family with crisp, succulent, green leaves, used for salads; lettuce.
example_en: There was fresh lettuce on the plate.

definition: the state or fact of being astonished; amazement; astonishment.
example: ಆ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಥಕ್ಕು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Everyone was astonished on seeing that result.

definition: a common variety of sparrows that is found in human habitats (as distinguished from the variety that lives in the wild).
example_en: The house sparrow builds its nest on the roof of the house.

definition: to cross the limit ot limits; to overstep.
example_en: His achievement exceeded everyone's expectations.

definition: a man addicted or being enslaved to a habit or practice obsessively; an addict.
example_en: He, an addict to drinking, ruined his life.

definition: the act of writing.
example_en: The act of writing took a lot of time.

definition: to cause to pour (a liquid) freely down.
example_en: The cook had the oil poured into the pan.

definition: (one's strength, vigour) to diminish, dwindle.
example_en: As he grew older, his strength dwindled.

definition: to scatter, strew about.
example_en: The children scattered flowers in the courtyard.

definition: the portion of the belly below the navel in human.
example_en: A pain appeared in the lower part of his belly below the navel.

definition: once more; again.
example_en: He tried once more and won.

definition: to bring down the intensity, extent, etc.
example_en: The government brought down the rate of the tax.

definition: to tie, bind firmly.
example_en: The fisherman firmly tied the net to the boat.

definition: to cause to hold back from action or to cause another to do at one's will; to keep under control; to make submissive.
example_en: The teacher strictly disciplined and controlled the students.

definition: absence of a base, support, etc.
example_en: His argument lacked any basis or support.

definition: a large boulder.
example_en: There was a large boulder at the top of the hill.

definition: a main road of a city.
example_en: The procession moved along the main road of the city.

definition: a particular game played by boys.
example_en: During the school break, the children played kattungare.

definition: the acting of pulling towards; attraction.
example_en: There was an attraction in that sight.

definition: the blood that is flowing out (of the body).
example_en: Blood was flowing out of the wound.

definition: a slight hollow or depression made in a surface by a blow or pressure.
example_en: A slight depression was seen on the wall.

definition: (jain.) a sleeping lightly or fitfully (as a stage in sleeping); doze.
example_en: At night he had a light doze and woke up.

definition: the quality of being hard; hardness.
example_en: Everyone knew the hardness of that stone.

definition: a brand in the form of a discus.
example_en: That king's seal had a discus brand.

definition: a clear, shrill sound made by whistling or blowing a whistle.
example_en: The traffic stopped at the sound of the policeman's whistle.

definition: fresh curd (curd that has not become sour).
example_en: Mother added a little sugar to the fresh curd.

definition: doubtful; uncertain; leading to suspect.
example_en: His words sounded doubtful and suspicious.

definition: a temporary state of extreme mental excitement, marked by restlessness, confused speech, and hallucinations; delirium.
example: ಜ್ವರ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದಾಗ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಗಳಗುಸನ್ನಿ ಬಂದು ಅಸಂಬದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: When the fever rose, delirium came upon him and he spoke incoherently.

definition: any game played with a ball.
example_en: The boys gathered in the evening to play a ball game.

definition: to greatly rejoice; to be delighted.
example_en: Getting the gift, the child was greatly delighted.

definition: Jesus of Nazareth, regarded by Christians as the realisation of the Messianic prophecy; Christ; (originally a title, Jesus the Christ, later used as part of the name (Jesus Christ).
example_en: They celebrate Christ's birthday as Christmas.

definition: (dial.) a sudden, involuntary contraction of the diaphragm when it begins to allow air into the lungs only to have the glottis suddenly close, producing an abrupt sound; hiccup.
example_en: He got hiccups while eating food.

definition: a man who shoots arrows (from a bow); an archer.
example_en: That archer is skilled in the art of archery.

definition: to cause to rob, plunder.
example: ಆ ದೊರೆ ಸೈನಿಕರನ್ನು ಶತ್ರುಪಟ್ಟಣವನ್ನು ಹರಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That king sent the soldiers to plunder the enemy town.
